description: Defines the ConnectingClientSocket class and its AsyncVisitor interface for connection-based socket communication in the QUIC protocol, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, reading, and writing asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: ConnectingClientSocket
classes.description: A connection-based client socket class providing methods for synchronous and asynchronous connect, disconnect, read, and write operations.

classes.name: ConnectingClientSocket::AsyncVisitor
classes.description: Interface for handling asynchronous connection events and I/O completion callbacks.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects or cancels an ongoing connection attempt.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveBlocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking read of up to max_size bytes.

methods.name: SendBlocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking send of data.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous send of data.
